label: Round Cuff
description: The round cuff features gently curved corners at the sleeve opening, softening the transition from sleeve to hand and giving a more relaxed, organic feel than square or angled alternatives. It is the most forgiving and fluid of the standard cuff shapes, well suited to softer-construction jackets, sport coats, and casual suits where a gentler silhouette is desired. The rounded corners also prevent the cuff edge from catching inside the sleeve lining when dressing, and the style is widely favoured by Italian and Neapolitan tailors who prize ease and natural drape above rigid formality.
